newsitem.title: TURKEY: FUGITIVE NADIR SAYS WILL RETURN TO TURKEY.
newsitem.headline: FUGITIVE NADIR SAYS WILL RETURN TO TURKEY.

text.p: Fugitive Turkish Cypriot tycoon Asil Nadir vowed on Thursday to return to Turkey, four years after jumping bail in Britain.
"I intend to go to Turkey," Nadir told Reuters by telephone from his home in northern Cyprus. He said his visit was imminent, but gave no further details.
Nadir has in the past invested in electronics companies, a hotel and the media in Turkey. He did not elaborate on the nature of any future investments in Turkey.
Nadir fled in May 1993 while awaiting trial on theft and false accounting charges following the collapse of his London-based Polly Peck fruits-to-electronics empire.
He still has media, banking and tourism interests in breakaway northern Cyprus.
Turkey invaded northern Cyprus in 1974 after a short-lived military coup on the island. Only Ankara recognises the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus.
